messages:
maya: quick postmortem follow-up for the GPU autoscale incident. listing owners and a short schedule so we can close the loop. please ACK the item you take.

maya: action items:
1) default quota buffer -> set to 12% with team override (owner: rachel)
2) scheduler experiment -> run adaptive-packing trial start=0.66, min=0.58 (owner: sam)
3) headroom stress -> 72h soak with injected microbursts (owner: paul)
4) request preflight guard -> middleware check projecting headroom >=6% (owner: om)
5) canary plan & rollback -> staged canary: smoke 20m, soak 2h, full 6h with rollback hook (owner: ops-bot + maya)
6) runbook + postmortem update -> add remediation checklist + dashboard panels (owner: maya)

maya: proposed timeline: PRs by Tue EOD, sim Wed-Thu, canary next Mon, observe 5 business days post-rollout.
rachel: ill own the quota change and add API guardrails. will open PR and include feature flag.
paul: taking the 72h soak. need traces -- maya can you post the S3 path?
om: will add the preflight middleware and unit tests. i'll coordinate with infra-ci for smoke tests.
sam: scheduler perf sweep sounds good. ill run packing=[0.6,0.62,0.66], preempt_backoff=[300,800], run=2h each and post a cost/latency matrix.
maya: s3://redwood-ops/postmortem/traces/2026-03-gpu-burst-v5.tar.lz4 (anonymized). paul ping when you start.

ops-bot: ci: quota-buffer PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4501 (author: rachel)

rachel: PR includes default_project_buffer=1.12*baseline and an opt-out override. marking feature_flag=false by default.
om: middleware PR draft up, including projected_headroom_pct check and a short integration test.
paul: started 72h soak on dev-grid. uploading artifacts to /sim-results/3409876543-soak.tar.gz. first 8h: buffer removed several transient evictions, p99 uplift ~3.1% on worst tails.
sam: perf sweep started; initial results show adaptive start=0.66 gives good eviction reduction with ~4% cost delta; posting full matrix soon.

maya: canary abort criteria proposal: eviction_rate>1/min OR p99 uplift>12% OR quota_headroom_pct<5%. OK?
rachel: OK. will gate rollout behind +2 reviewers.
om: middleware feature flag=false; will flip only for canary. infra-ci will run smoke tests.

ops-bot: canary-runner: scheduled canary cr-3409876543 on prod-canary-14 (stages: smoke->soak->full).

ops-bot: canary: smoke complete (20m) — no evictions, p99 +0.9%. proceeding to soak.

ops-bot: canary: full stage complete (6h) — result=PASS. metrics: eviction_rate=0, p99+2.2%, cost_delta=+4.3%.

paul: final soak report uploaded: https://drive.redwood/sim-reports/3409876543-final.pdf — summary: 12% buffer + adaptive packing reduces eviction tail by ~75% while keeping p99 impact <3% for most mixes.
sam: final recommendation: adaptive start=0.66, min=0.58, cost_guard=6%.
maya: next steps: rachel -> merge quota PR after reviews; om -> merge middleware and coordinate infra smoke; sam -> post knob rec in issue; paul -> archive sim artifacts and attach final report to postmortem; maya -> update runbook and schedule 3 weekly 15-min pulse checks (week1 rachel, week2 sam, week3 paul). once 2 clean weeks pass i'll close actions.
rachel: ack.
om: ack.
paul: ack.
sam: ack.
maya: thanks all  i'll post closure ticket when observation window completes. :white_check_mark:
